candidates.video_title: Venus Retrograde in Scorpio — Love Is Being Tested
candidates.video_description: Venus is currently retrograde at 6° Scorpio, forcing a deep audit of desire, attachment, and what you've been tolerating. This isn't a breakup season — it's a reckoning.
candidates.script: Venus is retrograde in Scorpio right now — and it doesn't care how comfortable you've gotten. At 6 degrees Scorpio, this retrograde pulls relationships into the dark and asks: is this real, or is this just fear of being alone? Astrologers read Venus retrograde as a period of reassessment — old connections resurface, hidden resentments come out, and what you truly value becomes impossible to ignore. This isn't about drama. It's about truth. What are you holding onto that no longer holds you back?

candidates.topic: Five Planets Retrograde — The Collective Slowdown
candidates.teaser: Five planets are retrograde at the same time right now — here's what that actually means for you.
candidates.video_title: 5 Planets Retrograde Right Now — What's Really Happening
candidates.video_description: Venus, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto are all currently retrograde. This kind of stacking is rare, and in astrology it signals a profound collective pause across love, structure, innovation, dreams, and power.
candidates.script: Five planets are retrograde right now — Venus, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune, and Pluto — all moving backward at the same time. In astrology, retrogrades are periods of revision, and when five stack together like this, the message is hard to ignore: the universe is asking you to stop building outward and start auditing what already exists. Love, ambition, freedom, belief, power — all under review simultaneously. This isn't chaos. Astrologers call this a collective correction. The question is whether you're resisting it or using it.

candidates.topic: The Astrological 6th House — Daily Habits and Hidden Health
candidates.teaser: Your 6th house is the most underrated placement in your entire birth chart — and most people completely ignore it.
candidates.video_title: The 6th House — The Most Overlooked Part of Your Chart
candidates.video_description: The 6th house rules daily routines, work environment, physical health, and acts of service. It's not glamorous, but it quietly shapes more of your daily life than almost any other house.
candidates.script: Nobody talks about the 6th house — but it runs your entire life. In traditional astrology, this is the house of daily routine, physical health, and the work you do just to keep things functioning. It's not glamorous like the 5th or mysterious like the 8th. But the sign on your 6th house cusp describes exactly how your body handles stress, why certain jobs drain you, and what your daily rhythm actually needs to feel stable. Check yours. It explains more than your sun sign ever will.

candidates.script: The Moon is in Scorpio today at 26 degrees — and that is not a soft placement. Scorpio Moon doesn't float on the surface of feelings. It goes straight to the bottom. But it's also one of the most honest skies of the month. What keeps coming back to your mind right now?
